naming_disambiguation.rule: Do not conflate delay-protocol D with biological-RBS protocol D in receipts or manuscript Figure 5/6.

question: Can one biologically interpretable RBS realization extend an existing emitter while recovering the classical emitter when RBS is frozen?

containment_thesis.equivalence_standard: bit-exact where implementation permits (float32, deterministic drive, noise_scale=0)
containment_thesis.classical_reference: same emitter kernel without active RBS coordinate coupling (beta_H_to_x=0 and/or g(H) identically 1)

causal_chain.plasticity: dot W = 0 (RBD only; HDP out of scope)
causal_chain.upstream_feed_prohibited: phenotype metrics do not feed back into F_H tuning after observation
causal_chain.distinction_from_protocol_c: Protocol C asked whether activity exhibits propagation; Protocol D asks whether biological RBS extends emitter semantics with a recoverable classical limit.
causal_chain.distinction_from_protocol_h: Protocol H validated abstract scalar RBS memory under fixed W; Protocol D requires a named biological coordinate with typed emitter coupling and classical containment.

rbs_vector_grammar.rule: Grammar defines the vector; D1 implements one coordinate only. Do not implement Na/K/Ca simultaneously in D1.
rbs_vector_grammar.resolution_principle: RBS coordinate != claim of microscopic physical completeness; H_K may later refine into (H_gK, H_[K]i, H_[K]o, H_availability, ...) without changing grammar.

physical_interpretation.is: effective relative potassium-channel availability / gain state
physical_interpretation.nominal_reference: H_K = 1 means nominal channel availability relative to the declared baseline
physical_interpretation.future_refinement_allowed: H_K -> (H_gK, H_[K]i, H_[K]o, H_availability, ...) under same typed grammar

typed_coupling_Gamma.operator_role: emitter-local typed gain on a declared baseline conductance/recovery parameter
typed_coupling_Gamma.normalization: g(H_K=1) = 1 relative to classical baseline g_K^0
typed_coupling_Gamma.positivity_gate: H_K > 0 required wherever multiplicative map is used

d1_emitter_realization.candidate_from_h1b_inventory: parameter b effective gain (subthreshold recovery / leak-recovery analogue)
d1_emitter_realization.selection_rule: choose smallest Izhikevich-native target that realizes g_K^eff semantics without adding a separate adaptation subsystem
d1_emitter_realization.forbidden: source_scale readout-only gain; separate parallel adaptation ODE outside RBS grammar

dynamics_F_H.activity_coupling: optional kappa_K * I_rel or phenotype-appropriate drive; frozen at D2 not D0
dynamics_F_H.stability_gate: trajectories remain finite and H_K stays inside declared admissible interval under frozen drive

null_reference_behavior.coupling_off: Gamma(H_K) reduces to identity on classical emitter parameters
null_reference_behavior.required_outcome: E_extended bitwise matches E_classical on shared observables (V_m, spikes, sources) under identical drive/weights/seeds

static_sweep_before_dynamics.rationale: Validate H -> Gamma(H) -> X separately before testing F_H (mirrors W1/W2 decomposition)
hold_fixed: all other RBS coordinates inactive or at reference
primary_readouts: spike count / rate under frozen step drive
f-I curve shift or recovery-time proxy appropriate to selected emitter coupling
static_sweep_before_dynamics.success_d1: monotonic or otherwise falsifiable static phenotype separation across the three H_K levels with classical null at H_K=1

targets: spike width or instantaneous rate trajectory
other emitter-appropriate phenotype without separate adaptation subsystem

D1.name: static typed-coordinate expression
D1.scope: H_K fixed sweep; Gamma(H_K) only; dH_K/dt=0

D2.name: dynamic F_H + recovery/stability
D2.scope: activate R_K(H_K) and optional activity coupling under dot W=0

D3.name: biological phenotype protocol
D3.scope: prospective falsifiable phenotype under frozen drive/nulls

D4.name: optional second RBS class
D4.scope: only if D3 outcome justifies; not Na/K/Ca name-only proliferation

runtime_contract.plasticity_scope: RBD on H only; synaptic weights fixed
runtime_contract.classical_baseline: same topology/weights/drive as extended model with RBS coupling nulled
runtime_contract.rationale: First biological RBS example demonstrates RBD containment, not closed-loop HDP (W3 unresolved).

falsification_and_stability_gates.finiteness: all state components finite over frozen simulation horizon
falsification_and_stability_gates.no_hidden_plasticity: weight tensors unchanged unless a future protocol explicitly authorizes HDP
valid_negative_outcomes: static sweep shows no phenotype separation (falsifies chosen Gamma target)
classical null not recovered within tolerance (implementation defect gate)

manuscript_figure_discipline.protocol_c: Figure 5 — wave estimator negative (60/60 NO_WAVE); narrow claim only
manuscript_figure_discipline.rule: C3 and H4 are joint examples of falsification discipline but answer different scientific questions; keep separate panels and narrative.
